summary: 8 XP boxes (.110 .123 .124 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) were re-verified in the same running Carmageddon 2 race on the dev host. Each fresh frame shows the shared 9-car scoreboard with the box's own row highlighted, and each box sent sustained packets to the host's private IPXWrapper port. .243 ran single-player only and its render is unproven (BLOCKED). .186 is NA. The game was closed on all 9 boxes and each desktop is back at its normal mode.
issues: lanparty check cannot witness this title by itself: its roster shows 0 and packets=None because the title has no query port. The proof is the host lobby frame plus a manual sniff of the IPXWrapper port 48703.
Close: 7 XP boxes needed a forced kill after the 12 s WM_CLOSE grace (no graceful in-game quit). .124 closed gracefully. .243 was PROCKILLed.
.243's Voodoo 2 render is never photographed; a person is needed to confirm it.

The kill printed no GLRESET9 confirmation for .243 even though the round notes say it needs one. Its desktop reads 800x600x16 with Shell_TrayWnd in the foreground, but nobody checked whether the screen is still on the Voodoo 2 pass-through.
carmageddon2-server state.json reports players=0 while racing, so it does not count players.
